title: Ackee and Umami German Breakfast
description: A unique twist on traditional German breakfast with ackee added to scrambled eggs and topped with umami-infused cheese.

ingredients.name: Umami powder
ingredients.notes: Add to scrambled eggs for depth of flavor

ingredients.name: Cheese (such as Emmental)
ingredients.notes: Umami-infused cheese or regular cheese works

instructions: 1. Crack eggs into a bowl and whisk until smooth.
2. Add umami powder to eggs and whisk to combine.
3. Heat butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
4. Pour in egg mixture and scramble eggs until cooked through.
5. Add chopped ackee to eggs and stir to combine.
6. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
7. Serve hot over German rye bread.
8. Top with shredded cheese and serve immediately.
